marketLayer.title: HK Tech Giants & AI Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: Major Hong Kong-listed tech leaders including Alibaba and Tencent expanded AI cloud infrastructure investments alongside active share buyback executions during the session.
marketLayer.inference: Increased capex may temporarily pressure short-term margins, but robust buyback programs provide a valuation floor and enhance long-term earnings per share growth.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization speed of generative AI enterprise services and potential escalation in global semiconductor supply chain restrictions.

marketLayer.title: US Fed Rate Trajectory & Mega-Cap Tech Volatility
marketLayer.fact: Resilient US macro economic indicators combined with moderating core inflation data led to recalibrated market expectations regarding the Federal Reserve's rate easing schedule.
marketLayer.inference: A higher-for-longer rate environment favors cash-rich mega-cap balance sheets over high-leverage growth names, maintaining narrow market breadth in US equities.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Upcoming Federal Reserve policy statements and sustainability of consumer spending strength in the second half.

marketLayer.title: HK Biotech Out-Licensing Momentum
marketLayer.fact: Several HKEX-listed innovative pharmaceutical firms announced multi-million dollar global out-licensing deals for oncology and metabolic drug pipelines with multinational pharma.
marketLayer.inference: Cross-border asset monetization validates domestic R&D capabilities and provides crucial non-dilutive capital reserves to sustain late-stage trial funding.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Phase III clinical trial outcomes, international regulatory approval hurdles, and execution of commercialization partnerships.
